comment: Each one-line notice that a rule can post, and whether it lands in the notice log of the menu (D-221, D-983). The log field is required, so the writer marks each notice. The line of a notice lives in the string table under the id of the notice (G-7). PR-62 holds two fixture notices, one of each kind, which the debug console posts (D-989). PR-14 adds the notices of the services of a hub: a closed service, a rest, and a save (D-1131, D-1132). PR-16 moves the save to the save point and adds the notices of the door and the chest. PR-64 adds the notices of a trap and of a character that the map downs, which logs (D-1226, D-1234). A notice of a chest names a thing in the singular or a count, so it never logs (D-1221, D-1224). The task and the key item of later PRs add their own notices here. PR-35 adds the notice of the closed fixture gate, which a confirm at the gate posts (D-1257). PR-17 adds the notice of the barred stair door of the hanging cells (D-1347).
